# U1: Weekly check-in, all due goals in one pass

- **Belongs to:** the core ([the journeys](../journeys.md)); it runs with every module on, and the core journeys run again with each module left out
- **Requirements:** `UPDATE-ANYTIME`, `CARRY-OVER`, `CHECKIN-STATUS-VS-PLAN`, `REASON-BEHIND`, `PATH-TO-GREEN`, `ONE-PER-WEEK`, `CHANGE-LOG`, `DRAFTS`, `PROFILES`, `PERSIST`
- **Budget:** at most 17 steps on each width
- **Ease test:** all ten points ([the ease test](../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As Rhea, at `/` in the demo.
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, the entry for U1

## Steps and checks

- _Note:_ Rhea: two goals due. Image slimming is on plan (number, post, next: three interactions); the new CI cost goal comes in a cent better than its plan (0.40 against 0.41, well ahead of a small first step), so it asks why, and she says.
- Open a fresh browser as Rhea (`rhea`).
- Go to `/` in the demo.
- **Check:** “2 check-ins to do” is shown.
- **Check:** (`entry`) the “Start check-in” link is in view without scrolling (above the phone’s tab bar).
- **Check:** Checkpoint “home”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- **Step.** Press the “Start check-in” link.
- **Check:** (`progress`) a progress indicator (a ring, steps, dots, a checklist or a bar) is visible.
- **Step.** Type {reviewV} into the “This week’s value” field.
- _Note:_ The gap in the words every list uses, whichever way is better; the line under it names the week it compares with.
- **Check:** “ahead of plan” is shown (else: the verdict says how it stands against the plan).
- **Check:** “planned for week 45” is shown (else: the verdict names the week it compares with).
- **Check:** Checkpoint “first goal”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- **Step.** Press the “Post check-in” button.
- **Check:** “Check-in saved” is shown.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “posted”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- **Step.** Press the “Next:” button.
- _Note:_ Leave mid-way and come back: the typed value is restored.
- Type “0.40” into the “This week’s value” field.
- Go to `/` in the demo.
- **Check:** “Pick up where you left off” is shown (else: a draft is offered back on home).
- Press the “Pick up where you left off” link.
- **Check:** It fails if the draft value was not restored.
- _Note:_ Its first check-in, off its plan: it offers to start the plan from this number (OB2, rule 4). Rhea keeps the plan and says why.
- **Step.** Press the “Keep … and say why” button.
- **Step.** Press the “Continue” button.
- **Step.** Press the “Change landed early” button.
- **Step.** Type “The runner budget came through a week early.” into the “What happened” field.
- **Step.** Press the “Post check-in” button.
- _Note:_ The last post is the only confirmation: what was saved, that the week is done, and a way on. The receipt (habit spec 2.1): every check-in in, before the review or after it.
- **Check:** “(Your check-in is / Both of your check-ins are / All N of your check-ins are) in” is shown (else: the last post says the week is done).
- **Check:** (`finish`) the “Back to home” link is visible and the “View the goal” link is visible (else: no way on from the confirmation).
- **Check:** Checkpoint “done”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- **Check:** (`logged`) met when `posts.length === 2 && posts.every((c) => c.diffs.some((d) => d.field === 'Value'))`, where `const s0 = await h.snapshot()`; `let s = await h.snapshot()`; `const before = new Set(s0.changes.map((c) => c.id))`; `` const posts = s.changes.filter((c) => !before.has(c.id) && c.actorId === 'rhea' && c.action === 'posted' && new RegExp(`week ${NOW}:`).test(c.summary)) ``; `NOW` is 45. Else it says: expected two logged week-45 posts by Rhea, saw {posts.length}.
- Go to `/` in the demo.
- Reload the page.
- If the Reviews module is on:
  - _Note:_ Rhea is in no review this week (hers is on Tuesday), so Home says the week is done in one sentence (HM1). On the day it is completed, Home says the check-in's receipt (habit spec 2.1); on a later day, the week.
  - **Check:** “(Your check-in is / Both (of your )?check-ins are / All N (of your )?check-ins are) in( for week / before / by / .)” is shown (else: posted check-ins survive a reload, and home says the week is done).
- Otherwise:
  - _Note:_ Without Reviews, Daniel's question waits by its own age, not for Tuesday's session: nine days, so it leads Home (rule 3), and nothing is left to check in on.
  - **Check:** “Daniel asked a question” is shown (else: without Reviews, the question nine days old leads Home).
  - **Check:** (`finish`) the words “check-ins to do” is not there (else: posted check-ins do not survive a reload: Home still counts check-ins to do).
- _Note:_ An ad hoc check-in, any time, from the goal page: kept alongside the first, and the latest is the week's status.
- Go to `/goals/ci-docker` in the demo.
- _Note:_ Checked in already: the owner's check-in is no longer the page's main action; "Check in again" is beside it.
- **Step.** Press Check in again on the goal’s summary bar.
- **Check:** “You checked in for week 45 already” is shown (else: a second check-in says it is kept alongside the first).
- **Step.** Type {reviewV2} into the “This week’s value” field.
- **Step.** Press the “Post check-in” button.
- **Check:** “Kept alongside your earlier check-in this week” is shown.
- **Check:** (`logged`) met when `` !!again && new RegExp(`Checked in again for week ${NOW}`).test(again.summary) && weekCis.length === 2 && weekCis.some((c) => c.value === Number(reviewV)) && weekCis.some((c) => c.value === Number(reviewV2)) ``, where `const s0 = await h.snapshot()`; `const g0 = (id) => s0.goals.find((g) => g.id === id)`; `const reviewV = String(Math.round(planAt(g0('ci-docker').plan, NOW)) - 2)`; `let s = await h.snapshot()`; `const reviewV2 = String(Number(reviewV) + 1)`; `const again = s.changes.filter((c) => c.actorId === 'rhea' && c.goalId === 'ci-docker' && c.action === 'posted').pop()`; `const weekCis = s.checkIns.filter((c) => c.goalId === 'ci-docker' && c.week === NOW)`; `NOW` is 45. Else it says: the ad hoc check-in is not kept alongside the first, or not logged.
- Close this browser.
- _Note:_ Rhea again, on the north star that is behind plan (a fresh browser, so her week is still open). One question per screen: the number, then last week's note offered back. "Still true" carries it over and posts; an empty number is explained in place.
- Open a fresh browser as Rhea (`rhea`).
- Go to `/check-in/ns-lead` in the demo.
- Press the check-in’s main button.
- **Check:** (`errors`) an alert showing “Type this week’s number” is visible (else: an empty number says nothing).
- **Step.** Type {a number 50% of the way from the goal’s start to its plan for week 45} into the “This week’s value” field.
- **Check:** (`attention`) the verdict, marked off plan is visible (else: behind plan is not flagged in the verdict).
- **Step.** Press the “Continue” button.
- _Note:_ Its week-45 check-in is already in (4 Nov), so this one corrects it: the note offered back is this week's (review F10).
- **Check:** “Is what you said in this week’s earlier check-in still true?” is shown (else: last week’s reason and path are offered back).
- **Check:** (`progress`) a progress indicator (a ring, steps, dots, a checklist or a bar) is visible.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “carry”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- _Note:_ What "Still true" will carry, the open request included, is shown before posting (product review, 3 Nov).
- **Check:** (`attention`) the words “Still asking:” is visible (else: the request that Still true carries forward is not shown).
- **Step.** Press the “Still true” button.
- If the “Back on plan by” group is visible:
  - **Step.** Press a button in the “Back on plan by” group.
  - **Step.** Press the “Post check-in” button.
- **Check:** “Check-in saved” is shown.
- **Check:** (`logged`) met when `!!c && c.diffs.some((d) => d.field === 'Path to green') && c.diffs.some((d) => /Merge queue/.test(d.to))`, where `let s = await h.snapshot()`; `const c = s.changes.filter((x) => x.actorId === 'rhea' && x.action === 'posted').pop()`. Else it says: Rhea’s carried-over reason and path are not in the log.
- Close this browser.
